messages:
meera-support: FYI escalated from Acme: tool call to price_lookup returns 400 malformed args + intermittent 401 auth errors in the same 30m window, and their billing meter spiked. Customer blocked, asking for repro/runbook.

ben-eng: Can you paste the exact request payload and headers? suspect trailing comma or non-JSON body.

meera-support: Pasting from customer (redacted):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/invoke \\n  -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk_live_xxx\" \\n  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\n  -d '{"model":"price-v1","input":"Get price for item 123","tools":[{"name":"price_lookup","args":{"id":"123","currency":"USD",}}]}'
```
Response: 400 {"error":"schema.validation","details":"tools[0].args: unexpected trailing comma"}

dmitry-ml: trailing comma explains the 400. What about the 401s? any token rotation or TTL logs in that window?

meera-support: 401s from same org between 14:02-14:10 UTC. Token shown was sk_live_xxx (they store in vault). Auth logs show `auth-service WARN token_expired` for token id 0x9f but token expiry metadata shows valid until later.

infra-oncall: I see a spike on auth-db TTL GC around 14:00 UTC — a background cleanup regened a cache entry. Also billing metering job started at 13:58. Could be a brief race where cached key was unavailable.

ben-eng: Billing spike numbers?

meera-support: Metering shows +20k small requests in a 6m window for that org, but customer insists they only did a handful. Seems correlated with repeated retries on 400s.

ci-bot: golden-eval pipeline failed at 13:57 for toolcall schema tests: `test_tool_schema` failed with `unexpected extra commas` after parser bump. https://ci.internal/2143

dmitry-ml: That fits: parser upgrade deployed at ~13:50 tightened JSON parsing (no trailing commas). Previously tolerant parser accepted trailing commas, so we now reject them -> 400s in prod and CI failures.

ben-eng: Action items: 1) hotfix to tolerate/strip trailing commas at the gateway or runtime pre-parse, 2) update error message to be more actionable, 3) update golden tests to catch this regression. Thoughts?

meera-support: Customer asks for immediate workaround. Can we add a temporary sanitizer that strips trailing commas in tool args only?

infra-oncall: We can push a lightweight L7 sanitizer rule to strip common trailing commas from JSON bodies. Low risk and quick. Will prepare canary. Note: may mask buggy clients.

dmitry-ml: Also update eval suite: add tests that generate plausible malformed args (trailing commas, single quotes, unescaped control chars) and assert behavior or fail gate on parser changes. We should have caught this in CI.

ben-eng: I'll open a PR for compatibility layer + better error detail. Also add metric tagging tying 400s to parser-version header to speed future triage.

meera-support: I'll notify the customer with workaround and ETA for hotfix, advise retry after canary.

alex-product: Add a short note in release notes: parser stricter -> may return 400 for malformed JSONs. Recommend clients validate or migrate. Offer compatibility toggle for enterprise customers if needed.

meera-support: Thanks. :thumbsup: Please ping when canary is up.

ben-eng: PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/runtime/+/4321 — patch strips trailing commas from tool args array only. Starting canary deploy now.

infra-oncall: Canary healthy at 2143654375. No auth 401s observed in canary traces. Sanitizer removed trailing commas from ~18 requests.

meera-support: Customer confirmed through support channel that calls succeeded at 14:23 UTC and billing meter normalized. They will clean up clients long-term. Closing once PR lands and RELEASE note published.

ben-eng: Merged and scheduled full rollout. Will also add CI golden test change.

meera-support: Closing loop. Thanks team.
